natural_power_ceiling_hypothesis: Bracket 4 optimized combat/Voltron with 7-mana commander dependency
rules_observations: Staff ping plus deathtouch requires two additional generic mana for each repeated ping; not a free infinite loop
Kediss reflected damage is sourced from Kediss, not from Garza; it is not commander combat damage
Nova Flame gives counters before Garza deals damage to each other creature, including own creatures
Fireshrieker gives two combat damage steps and can create two Garza draw triggers on two successful connections
Quietus Spike life loss is not commander damage
Chandra's Ignition and Nova Flame damage is not combat damage
Aggravated Assault and Sword of Feast and Famine need Sword hit, legal main-phase activation and real red mana to repeat
provenance_limitation: Prior work in the same model family and potential latent earlier-session exposure cannot be erased. Reduced-exposure review, not technically independent or provably blind.
